//site: ABVIMAS Manali (abvimas.org) is server-rendered PHP. noticesUrl = the Notice Board table, where every booking opening is announced (for skiing: one notice per batch, posted 1-6 days before, e.g. 'Booking for Basic & Advance Skiing Course [27-01-2026 to 09-02-2026] Will be open on 24th January, 2026 at 11:00 AM'). applyFirstUrl = Apply Online step 1, whose Session dropdown lists the open sessions. Step 2 (/course/apply-second-step/<sessionId>/<activityId>/<sessionName>/<activitySlug>) is the booking table with Available Seats; activityId 2 = Skiing/Snowboarding. courseUrl = the Basic Snow Skiing course page with its seat chart (activity codes, dates).
//match: skiPattern: a notice or booking row counts as skiing if it matches (word-bounded, so 'skill' doesn't). targetPattern: the course you want (Basic Snow Skiing) — its rows get seat-change alerts; every other skiing row only alerts when it first appears.
//notify: Your ntfy topic is SECRET (it is the only password on free ntfy.sh) -> set NTFY_TOPIC in the .env file, NOT here. reminderMinutesBefore: when a notice says when booking opens, urgent pushes this many minutes before (0 = 'open now'). lowSeats: one high-priority push when your course's seats drop below this.
//watch: intervalMinutes between regular checks: a skiing booking notice can come as little as ~23 h before opening, so check often. Around a known opening (fastBeforeMinutes before to fastAfterMinutes after) it checks every fastIntervalSeconds, so the 'booking is LIVE + seats' push lands within a minute. jitterSeconds randomizes timing a little.
